button.negative: Decrement index on 10ms tick until target, wrap36

menu.plaque_policy: Current submenu selector853 uses MenuSubN; other rows use MenuSubN2. Row index is not main category index.
menu.navigation: Up/Down clamp submenu, extras row and save row/scroll; Left/Right cycle main categories
menu.extras_gates: MenuCode/83B can restrict selection;861==0 forces visible count1/selector0. Unlock rules remain incomplete.

triggers.submenu: 4C2130 /4C30A0: mSubMenu played while initializing category plaques
triggers.confirm: 4C15E0: opening load/extras and accepting selections use mDecide
triggers.cancel: 4BBAC0 WM_KEYDOWN Escape clears flags/selectors without a sound call
triggers.move: 4BFAC0 /4C0260 mUpdown on changed submenu or extras row; save row path has its own boundary details
triggers.gallery: 4C15E0 stops/frees950 then loads selected track and loops;4BBAC0 Escape only clears list selectors, retaining current950 track;4BDA10 stops/frees950 when leaving main menu

evidence.authority: Source carrier bytes plus native Ghidra static calls; not original runtime observation

limitations: Native alpha overlays use 5-bit preweighted color and RGB565 destination quantization; PNG exports preserve source color/alpha with browser rounding differences.
MenuCode registry and extras unlock gates are retained as unknown; assets include selected/normal row variants without claiming completion unlocks.
Read panel images are original; actual remake save metadata must be rendered from browser saves, never inferred from original user save bytes.
